text:
- chief complaint: Follow-up for weight gain and acne, with review of lab results.
- history of present illness: The patient returns after stopping birth control, with improved liver enzymes. Labs ruled out Cushing's syndrome and showed normal androgen levels, high cholesterol, and vitamin D deficiency. Thyroid medication cost is a barrier.
- physical examination: Lungs and heart examined; feet and ankles appeared normal.
- symptoms experienced by the patient: Weight gain, foot swelling, constipation, acne, and skin sensitivity with rashes from products.
- new medications prescribed or changed, including dosages: Topical clindamycin and benzoyl peroxide, prescribed separately (dosage N/A); Unithroid with discount card (dosage N/A); vitamin D 2000 IU daily after current course; Phexxi before intercourse (dosage N/A); MiraLAX for constipation (dosage N/A); birth control discontinued.
- follow-up instructions: Repeat all labs before next visit; apply benzoyl peroxide at night; follow a low-carb diet and avoid alcohol and fatty foods; compare pharmacy prices with printed prescriptions; call within a month about the weight loss study; report worsening foot swelling.
